entries.title: Psalms 41:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Blessed is he that understandeth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

entries.title: Psalms 41:2
segments: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive; he shall be made happy in the land; and thou wilt not deliver him to the will of his enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 41:3
segments: Jehovah will sustain him upon the bed of languishing: thou turnest all his bed in his sickness.

entries.title: Psalms 41:4
segments: As for me, I said, Jehovah, be gracious unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 41:5
segments: ¶Mine enemies wish me evil: When will he die, and his name perish?

entries.title: Psalms 41:6
segments: And if one come to see [me], he speaketh falsehood; his heart gathereth wickedness to itself: he goeth abroad, he telleth [it].

entries.title: Psalms 41:7
segments: All that hate me whisper together against me; against me do they devise my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 41:8
segments: A thing of Belial cleaveth fast unto him; and now that he is laid down, he will rise up no more.

entries.title: Psalms 41:9
segments: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I confided, who did eat of my bread, hath lifted up [his] heel against me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:10
segments: But thou, Jehovah, be gracious unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

entries.title: Psalms 41:11
segments: By this I know that thou delightest in me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:12
segments: But as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 41:13
segments: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity! Amen, and Amen.
